696.headline: What the prize table shows

762.body:
"Billion" is in the second half of its run, with about a third of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

The numbers for "Billion" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
762.headline: Where this game is in its run

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has gone over a month without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. Most of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $15 million prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

50th Anniversary's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Today's free summary of "50th Anniversary" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
827.headline: Top prizes have lasted so far

847.body:
All the top prizes on "Bingo 50X" have been claimed. That lowers the biggest prize from $500,000 to $100,000. Two of those are still out there. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

The numbers for "Bingo 50X" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
847.headline: No top prizes remain

891.body:
"Cash Explosion 25X" has 83,398 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with one left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Everything here about "Cash Explosion 25X" comes from official Ohio lottery numbers, current through November 12.
